local P = pandoc
local log = {}
local function t(s) return P.Str(s) end
local function H(level, text, attr) return P.Header(level, {t(text)}, attr or P.Attr()) end
local function cell(text) return P.Cell{P.Plain{t(text)}} end
local function show(value, depth)
  depth = depth or 0
  local kind = type(value)
  -- Not `%q`: its escapes depend on the C locale (row I-LUA-13).
  if kind == 'string' then
    return '"' .. value:gsub('[\0-\31\127"\\]', function(c) return '\\' .. c:byte() end) .. '"'
  end
  if kind == 'number' then return math.type(value) .. ':' .. tostring(value) end
  if kind == 'table' and depth < 6 then
    local mt = getmetatable(value)
    local name = mt and rawget(mt, '__name')
    if name == 'Inlines' or name == 'Blocks' then return name .. ' ' .. tostring(value) end
    local keys = {}
    for key in pairs(value) do keys[#keys + 1] = key end
    table.sort(keys, function(a, b) return tostring(a) < tostring(b) end)
    local parts = {}
    for _, key in ipairs(keys) do
      parts[#parts + 1] = show(key, depth + 1) .. '=' .. show(value[key], depth + 1)
    end
    return (name and (tostring(name) .. ' ') or '') .. '{' .. table.concat(parts, ', ') .. '}'
  end
  if kind == 'userdata' then return P.utils.type(value) .. ' ' .. tostring(value) end
  if kind == 'function' then return 'function' end
  return tostring(value)
end
local function probe(label, fn)
  local results = table.pack(pcall(fn))
  local parts = {}
  for i = 2, results.n do parts[#parts + 1] = show(results[i]) end
  -- Pandoc raises some errors as `PandocError` objects (row I-LUA-10):
  -- the text of an error is compared, not its type.
  if not results[1] then parts = {show(tostring(results[2]))} end
  local line = label .. (results[1] and ' => ' or ' !! ') .. table.concat(parts, ' | ')
  -- Addresses differ from run to run.
  log[#log + 1] = (line:gsub('0x%x%x%x%x+', 'ADDR'))
end

local function keys(value)
  local names = {}
  for key in pairs(value) do names[#names + 1] = key end
  return table.concat(names, ',')
end
local function with_files(callback)
  return P.system.with_temporary_directory('lua-wave8b', callback)
end
local function write(path, data)
  local handle = assert(io.open(path, 'wb'))
  assert(handle:write(data))
  assert(handle:close())
end

local function run(document)
local S=P.structure
local doc=P.Pandoc({
  P.Para{P.Link('inside','#leaf'),P.Space(),P.Link('missing','#absent')},
  H(1,'First',P.Attr('first',{'unlisted'})), H(2,'Child'),
  H(3,'Leaf'), H(2,'Child'), H(1,'Second'), H(3,'Deep'),
})
local function summary(cd)
  local result={}
  for i,c in ipairs(cd.chunks) do
    result[i]={c.id,c.level,c.number,c.path,c.unlisted,c.section_number,
      up=c.up and c.up.id,heading=c.heading,contents=c.contents}
  end
  return result
end
local function split(opts) return summary(S.split_into_chunks(doc,opts)) end
  probe('S.split_into_chunks()', function() return S.split_into_chunks() end)
  probe('S.split_into_chunks(nil)', function() return S.split_into_chunks(nil) end)
  probe('S.split_into_chunks({})', function() return S.split_into_chunks({}) end)
  probe('S.split_into_chunks(doc,false)', function() return S.split_into_chunks(doc,false) end)
  probe('S.split_into_chunks(doc,\039opts\039)', function() return S.split_into_chunks(doc,'opts') end)
  probe('S.split_into_chunks(doc,{chunk_level=\039bad\039})', function() return S.split_into_chunks(doc,{chunk_level='bad'}) end)
  probe('S.split_into_chunks(doc,{chunk_level=1.5})', function() return S.split_into_chunks(doc,{chunk_level=1.5}) end)
  probe('S.split_into_chunks(doc,{base_heading_level=\039bad\039})', function() return S.split_into_chunks(doc,{base_heading_level='bad'}) end)
  probe('S.split_into_chunks(doc,{path_template=false})', function() return S.split_into_chunks(doc,{path_template=false}) end)
  probe('split()', function() return split() end)
  probe('split({chunk_level=0})', function() return split({chunk_level=0}) end)
  probe('split({chunk_level=-2})', function() return split({chunk_level=-2}) end)
  probe('split({chunk_level=2,number_sections=true,path_template=\039%n-%s-%i-%h-%%-%x-%\039})', function() return split({chunk_level=2,number_sections=true,path_template='%n-%s-%i-%h-%%-%x-%'}) end)
  probe('split({chunk_level=3,number_sections=0})', function() return split({chunk_level=3,number_sections=0}) end)
  probe('split({base_heading_level=2})', function() return split({base_heading_level=2}) end)
  probe('split({base_heading_level=2,chunk_level=2})', function() return split({base_heading_level=2,chunk_level=2}) end)
  probe('split({path_template=123})', function() return split({path_template=123}) end)
  probe('empty', function() return summary(S.split_into_chunks(P.Pandoc{})) end)
  probe('empty with level zero', function() return summary(S.split_into_chunks(P.Pandoc{},{chunk_level=0})) end)
  probe('intro title metadata', function() return summary(S.split_into_chunks(P.Pandoc({P.Para'plain'},{title='Probe'}))) end)
  probe('no headings', function() return summary(S.split_into_chunks(P.Pandoc{P.Para'plain'})) end)
  probe('explicit identifiers', function() return summary(S.split_into_chunks(P.Pandoc{H(1,'Same',P.Attr('same')),H(1,'Same'),H(1,'Same')})) end)
end

local function run(document)
local S=P.structure
local cd=S.split_into_chunks(P.Pandoc(
  {H(1,'One'),H(2,'Two'),H(3,'Three'),H(2,'Four'),H(1,'Five')},{title='Probe'}),
  {chunk_level=3,number_sections=true})
local a,b,c,d,e=table.unpack(cd.chunks)
local function tree(t)
  local e=t[0]
  local result={e.id,e.level,e.path,e.number,title=e.title}
  for i,child in ipairs(t) do result['child'..i]=tree(child) end
  return result
end
  probe('types', function() return P.utils.type(cd),P.utils.type(a),P.utils.type(cd.meta),P.utils.type(cd.toc),getmetatable(cd.chunks),getmetatable(cd.toc),P.utils.type(a.heading),P.utils.type(a.contents) end)
  probe('pairs', function() return keys(cd),keys(a),keys(c) end)
  probe('unknown keys', function() return cd.unknown,a.unknown,cd.t,a.t end)
  probe('chunked document string', function() return tostring(cd) end)
  probe('chunk record string', function() return tostring(a) end)
  probe('toc', function() return tree(cd.toc) end)
  probe('toc shape', function() local t=cd.toc; return t[0].id,t[0].path,#t,t[1][0].title,t[1][1][1][0].path,getmetatable(t[1][0]) end)
  probe('first links', function() return a.up,a.prev,a.next.id,a.next.up.id,a.next.prev.id,a.next.next end)
  probe('nested links', function() return c.up.id,c.up.up.id,c.up.prev,c.up.next,c.prev.id,c.prev.up.id,c.prev.prev,c.prev.next,c.next.id,c.next.prev.id,c.next.prev.prev,c.next.next end)
  probe('last links', function() return e.up,e.next,e.prev.id,d.up end)
  probe('link identity', function() return a.next==b,a.next==a.next,b.prev==a end)
  probe('cached fields', function() return cd.chunks==cd.chunks,cd.meta==cd.meta,cd.toc==cd.toc,rawequal(a.heading,a.heading),rawequal(a.contents,a.contents) end)
  probe('property writes', function() local copy=a.next; copy.id='new'; copy.heading=P.Inlines'title'; copy.contents=P.Blocks'body'; return copy.id,copy.heading,copy.contents,b.id end)
  probe('nil property', function() a.id=nil; return a.id end)
  probe('write link', function() a.next=e; return a.next.id end)
  probe('write chunked property', function() cd.meta={description='changed'}; return cd.meta.description end)
  probe('write unknown chunk key', function() a.extra=1 end)
  probe('write unknown doc key', function() cd.extra=1 end)
end

function Pandoc(document)
  run(document)
  return P.Pandoc({P.CodeBlock(table.concat(log, '\n'))})
end

local function run(document)
local S=P.structure
local blocks={H(1,'First',P.Attr('first')),H(2,'Sub',P.Attr('sub')),
  H(3,'Leaf',P.Attr('leaf')),H(4,'Deep',P.Attr('deep')),
  H(1,'Hidden',P.Attr('hidden',{'unlisted'})),H(2,'Child',P.Attr('child')),
  H(1,'Unnumbered',P.Attr('un',{'unlisted','unnumbered'})),H(2,'Child',P.Attr('un-child'))}
local doc=P.Pandoc(blocks)
local sectioned=S.make_sections(blocks,{number_sections=true})
local cd=S.split_into_chunks(doc,{chunk_level=2,number_sections=true,path_template='%i.html'})
  probe('S.table_of_contents()', function() return S.table_of_contents() end)
  probe('S.table_of_contents(nil)', function() return S.table_of_contents(nil) end)
  probe('S.table_of_contents(42)', function() return S.table_of_contents(42) end)
  probe('S.table_of_contents(false)', function() return S.table_of_contents(false) end)
  probe('S.table_of_contents(\039text\039)', function() return S.table_of_contents('text') end)
  probe('S.table_of_contents({})', function() return S.table_of_contents({}) end)
  probe('S.table_of_contents(blocks)', function() return S.table_of_contents(blocks) end)
  probe('S.table_of_contents(doc)', function() return S.table_of_contents(doc) end)
  probe('S.table_of_contents(cd)', function() return S.table_of_contents(cd) end)
  probe('S.table_of_contents(blocks,{toc_depth=0})', function() return S.table_of_contents(blocks,{toc_depth=0}) end)
  probe('S.table_of_contents(blocks,{toc_depth=-1})', function() return S.table_of_contents(blocks,{toc_depth=-1}) end)
  probe('S.table_of_contents(doc,{toc_depth=4})', function() return S.table_of_contents(doc,{toc_depth=4}) end)
  probe('S.table_of_contents(doc,{number_sections=true})', function() return S.table_of_contents(doc,{number_sections=true}) end)
  probe('S.table_of_contents(doc,P.WriterOptions{toc_depth=1,number_sections=true})', function() return S.table_of_contents(doc,P.WriterOptions{toc_depth=1,number_sections=true}) end)
  probe('S.table_of_contents(doc,{identifier_prefix=\039prefix-\039,toc_depth=1})', function() return S.table_of_contents(doc,{identifier_prefix='prefix-',toc_depth=1}) end)
  probe('S.table_of_contents(doc,\039opts\039)', function() return S.table_of_contents(doc,'opts') end)
  probe('S.table_of_contents(doc,{toc_depth=\039bad\039})', function() return S.table_of_contents(doc,{toc_depth='bad'}) end)
  probe('S.table_of_contents(doc,{unknown=1})', function() return S.table_of_contents(doc,{unknown=1}) end)
  probe('S.table_of_contents(cd,{number_sections=true,toc_depth=4})', function() return S.table_of_contents(cd,{number_sections=true,toc_depth=4}) end)
  probe('S.table_of_contents(sectioned,{toc_depth=1})', function() return S.table_of_contents(sectioned,{toc_depth=1}) end)
  probe('S.table_of_contents({H(1,\039No identifier\039)})', function() return S.table_of_contents({H(1,'No identifier')}) end)
  probe('S.table_of_contents(P.Para\039x\039)', function() return S.table_of_contents(P.Para'x') end)
  probe('S.table_of_contents(H(1,\039Heading\039))', function() return S.table_of_contents(H(1,'Heading')) end)
  probe('S.table_of_contents({P.Div({P.Para\039x\039},P.Attr(\039\039,{\039section\039}))})', function() return S.table_of_contents({P.Div({P.Para'x'},P.Attr('',{'section'}))}) end)
  probe('cached TOC writes', function() cd.toc[1][0].title=P.Inlines'new'; return S.table_of_contents(cd,{toc_depth=1}) end)
end

function Pandoc(document)
  run(document)
  return P.Pandoc({P.CodeBlock(table.concat(log, '\n'))})
end
